questiontext.text:
Which of the following is NOT a proper or conventional presentation of a set?

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

[[ if test="member(1, ta_index)" ]]

The correct answer is Set a={A,B,C,D}

This is not a conventional name for a set. By convention, names of sets should be capital letters.

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(2, ta_index)" ]]

The correct answer is Set B=1,2,3,4

This is not a proper way of representing a set, elements in a set are enclosed in curly brackets.

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(3, ta_index)" ]]

The correct answer is Set D=(1,2,3,4)

This is not a proper way of representing a set, elements in a set are enclosed in curly brackets.

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(4, ta_index)" ]]

The correct answer is Set E=[4,5,6,7]

This is not a proper way of representing a set, elements in a set are enclosed in curly brackets.

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(5, ta_index)" ]]

The correct answer is Set A={a b c d}

This is not a proper way of representing a set, elements in a set are separated by commas.

[[/ if ]]
